experiment: E3 history-gradient GMM treatment development pilot
implementation_status: explicit adaptation; not a faithful reproduction of the original Gradients algorithm
subset_policy: Within each source-label class, select min(256, available fit rows), ordered by SHA256(seed|group_sha256). All arms/noise conditions share that seed's subset.
noise_policy: Uniformly select floor(rate*n) training rows without replacement using seed+917; replace each label uniformly with one of the other classes. Same corruption for all arms. Never pass the noise rate, true labels or corruption mask to a treatment learner.
model_selection: None; fixed identical settings and rounds across arms; no early stopping. Calibration and test do not select or stop training.

treatment.gradient_definition: Post-update softmax cross-entropy residual p_k - 1[k=current_training_label]; maximum absolute residual over classes; arithmetic mean of the last five rounds.
treatment.candidate_rule: Among active, never-treated rows, high-mean GMM component posterior > 0.5. Fit GMM on all active residual-history means. Skip if fewer than four active rows or residual standard deviation <= 1e-8 or component means differ by <= 1e-8.
treatment.removal_class_guard: Retain at least one currently assigned-label row per class; rank candidates by descending gradient statistic, breaking ties by original local row index.
treatment.relabel_rule: Change a candidate at most once to the argmax of its five-round mean probabilities, only when different from its current label. Ties use lowest class index.
treatment.history_after_intervention: Clear histories after each scheduled intervention so subsequent gradients describe the updated labels/active roster.
treatment.last_intervention: Never intervene after the last training round; every recorded treatment must affect at least one subsequent update.

primary_metric: test macro-F1, fixed full six-class label set

screen.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of paired seed deltas; three fitting/subsampling seeds are not independent population replications; no confidence interval or significance claim.
screen.pass_rule: All four conditions must hold for the same treatment arm. Report both arms regardless of outcome; a passing arm is a promising development result requiring fresh confirmation.

limitations: Source labels are assumed correct for this controlled corruption study; it does not validate or repair real annotation errors.
Only the author's training CSV is available. Exact-feature deduplication does not remove all correlated flows or identify independent incidents.
No author holdout, temporal, early-warning, population, conformal or novelty claim.
InitialCompromise has 43 fit rows and 15 test rows; rare-stage recall is coarse and fragile.
The cap is unequal in realized per-class counts; this is a bounded training context, not a strict equal-label-budget sample-efficiency experiment.
Repeated adaptive treatment and rare-class retention are declared implementation choices and prevent claiming an exact reproduction of the named Gradients paper.
